verdict.rationale: Circle Payments Network documents cross-border fiat payouts: real-time FX quotes, settlement in USDC onchain, and payout partners delivering local fiat to the receiver (circle-docs-12). An endpoint returns the supported countries, currencies, payment methods and blockchains (circle-docs-45), and a managed mode has Circle handle licensing, custody, compliance and settlement (circle-docs-30). Circle Mint separately converts USDC to and from USD (circle-docs-13). Missing for 10: the actual published list of countries and currencies is not shown in the evidence, bank transfer is never named explicitly as a payout method, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of payouts landing in local fiat.
